description: This file defines the BuzzCommentAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. It implements RESTful endpoints for managing comments on buzz/shares, including retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting comments. It uses various traits, models, and exception handling to facilitate API operations for a human resource management system.

classes.name: BuzzCommentAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for CRUD operations on comments related to buzz/shares in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific comment by ID and share ID, returning the comment in the specified model format.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all comments associated with a specific share ID, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new comment on a specified share, including transaction management and updating comment count.

methods.name: setBuzzCommentText
methods.description: Sets the text of a BuzzComment entity from request parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing comment's text if update permissions are valid, with transaction control.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific comment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing comments.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a comment, including text length and model.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a comment.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific comment if authorized, updates comment count, and manages transaction.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting a comment.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines the return model class based on the 'model' query parameter.
